records.jp: 花火……綺麗ですね
records.en_original: The fireworks are beautiful...
records.en: The fireworks are beautiful...

records.jp: フッ、でもその花火よりも――
records.en_original: Heh, they're nothing compared to—
records.en: Heh, they're nothing compared to—

records.jp: でも花火より、それを見て笑ってる星崎さんの方が、<CR>もっと綺麗です
records.en_original: But your smile is even more beautiful than any firework.
records.en: But Hoshizaki-san smiling as she watches them<CR>is even more beautiful than the fireworks.

records.jp: えっ、あっ……ぁ、ありがとうございます……
records.en_original: U-uh, th-thank you...
records.en: U-uh, th-thank you...

records.jp: じゃあ、花火と私ならどっちが綺麗？
records.en_original: What's prettier, me or the fireworks?
records.en: What's prettier, me or the fireworks?

records.jp: 星崎さんです
records.en_original: You.
records.en: You, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ッ！？　な、なんでそんな即答！？
records.en_original: ?! Y-you didn't hesitate at all!
records.en: ?! Y-you didn't hesitate at all!

records.jp: 星崎さんの方が綺麗だと思ったからです
records.en_original: That's because you are.
records.en: Because I thought you were more beautiful, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ぅ、ぁ……あ、ありがとう
records.en_original: I-I, wha— ...Thank you.
records.en: I-I, wha— ...Thank you.

records.jp: な、なんか詩帆さん、今日はいつもと違くない……？
records.en_original: Y-you're acting different, Shiho.
records.en: Y-you're acting different, Shiho-san.

records.jp: 折角の花火デートなので、<CR>普段よりちょっと大胆になってみましたっ
records.en_original: It's not everyday I get to have a date like this, I guess I'm feeling a little daring.
records.en: Since this is a fireworks date,<CR>I thought I'd be a little bolder than usual.

records.jp: 大胆なわたしは嫌いですか……？
records.en_original: Or do you not like that...?
records.en: Or do you not like that...?

records.jp: ぜ、全然嫌いじゃないよ！<CR>ただ普段と雰囲気が違うからドキッとしただけで……
records.en_original: Th-that's not it at all! I was just surprised is all...
records.en: I-I don't dislike it at all!<CR>You just feel so different from usual that my heart skipped a beat...

records.jp: ふふっ、それならデートとしては成功ですね
records.en_original: Hehe, then it sounds like this date was a success.
records.en: Hehe, then it sounds like this date was a success.

records.jp: というわけで大胆続行です。えいっ
records.en_original: While I'm at it then... There!
records.en: So I guess I'll keep being bold. There!

records.jp: （普段とは違ってぐいぐい甘えてくる詩帆さん……<CR>な、なんていうか、破壊力がヤバイ）
records.en_original: (Shiho is usually never like this... She's dangerous!)
records.en: (Shiho-san is boldly acting spoiled in a way she normally never does...<CR>H-how do I put this? The destructive power is incredible.)

records.jp: 嫌いじゃない。むしろすごくいい！　<CR>けど、もっともっと大胆な詩帆さんも見て見たいな
records.en_original: I love it! Though I'd like to see you be even more daring if I'm being honest.
records.en: I love it! But I'd like to see<CR>an even bolder side of you, Shiho-san.

records.jp: もっともっとですか……
records.en_original: More...?
records.en: More...?

records.jp: わかりました。いきます
records.en_original: I understand. Here I go.
records.en: I understand. Here I go.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃ～ん、お姉さんとイイコトしてみなぁ～い？
records.en_original: Aooo, why don't we have some fun, hm?
records.en: Ao-chaaaan, would you like to do something nice with Onee-san~?

records.jp: 帰ります
records.en_original: I'll just head home now.
records.en: I'll just head home now.

records.jp: ま、ま待って待って！<CR>よかった、よかったよ詩帆さん！！
records.en_original: W-wait, wait! You did great! I promise!
records.en: W-wait, wait! It was<CR>good, Shiho-san! It really was!

records.jp: 嘘です絶対嘘です！　凄い空気を感じましたもん！<CR>わたしには大胆とか向いてなかったんです！
records.en_original: Forget about what just happened! It was so awkward! I'm not good at being daring!
records.en: That's a lie, absolutely a lie! I could feel how awkward it was!<CR>I'm just not cut out for being bold!

records.jp: うああああああん！
records.en_original: Waaaaaaah!
records.en: Waaaaaaah!

records.jp: （こ、このままじゃだめだ！<CR>こうなったら私も何か大胆なことをするか……？）
records.en_original: (This is bad! I need to do something bold...)
records.en: (This is bad! I<CR>need to do something bold...)

records.en_original: (I know!)
records.en: (I know!)

records.jp: 詩帆さん！　私が花火の大胆な見方を教えてあげるよ！
records.en_original: Shiho! I know a great way to watch fireworks!
records.en: Shiho-san! I know a great way to watch fireworks!

records.jp: こ、こんなところに座っていいんでしょうか……？
records.en_original: I-is it really okay for us to sit here?
records.en: I-is it really all right to sit in a place like this...?

records.jp: 普通はダメだけど、学校の周りが一面水で囲まれてて、<CR>さらにリフレクターがいる場合にだけオッケーなんだよ
records.en_original: Usually it wouldn't, but we've got Reflectors here, and the school is surrounded by water anyways.
records.en: Normally it's forbidden, but it's okay when<CR>the school is surrounded by water and we have Reflectors here.

records.jp: ふふっ。ならわたしたちは問題ないですね
records.en_original: Hehe. Then I suppose there's no problem.
records.en: Hehe. Then I suppose there's no problem.

records.jp: ……花火、綺麗です
records.en_original: It's beautiful...
records.en: It's beautiful...

records.jp: さっきの場所で見てた花火と、どっちが綺麗？
records.en_original: Which was prettier, the fireworks before or the ones now?
records.en: Which was prettier, the fireworks before or the ones now?

records.jp: うーん、星崎さんですかね
records.en_original: Hmm, can I still choose you?
records.en: Hmm... I'd say you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私は選択肢にないぞー
records.en_original: You can't choose me this time.
records.en: You can't choose me this time.

records.jp: じゃあ、今見てる花火の方にします
records.en_original: Then I choose these fireworks.
records.en: Then I choose these fireworks.

records.jp: やった
records.en_original: I'm glad.
records.en: I'm glad.

records.jp: どう？　寝転がって見る花火は
records.en_original: So? How are the fireworks from this angle?
records.en: So? How are the fireworks from this angle?

records.jp: 花火も、夜空もよく見えて綺麗です。<CR>でも、同時に……なんだか少し寂しい
records.en_original: Both the fireworks and night sky are beautiful, but... It's a little lonely.
records.en: I can see both the fireworks and the night sky clearly, and they are beautiful.<CR>But at the same time... somehow, it feels a little lonely.

records.jp: 寂しい……？
records.en_original: Lonely...?
records.en: Lonely...?

records.jp: ……空に咲いた花火は一瞬の輝きで、<CR>またすぐに暗い夜空に戻ってしまうから
records.en_original: Fireworks only last for a second. They shine bright, but the dark night always comes back.
records.en: ...Fireworks blooming in the sky shine only for an instant,<CR>and then it immediately returns to the dark night sky.

records.jp: それを思うと……少し
records.en_original: When I think like that I feel a little lonely...
records.en: When I think like that I feel a little lonely...

records.jp: なるほど。じゃあ――
records.en_original: That makes sense. Then how about—
records.en: That makes sense. Then how about—

records.jp: ずっと一緒にいてくれる愛央ちゃんだぞ
records.en_original: I'll always be here with you.
records.en: Then you have Ao-chan, who will always stay with you.

records.jp: 寂しくなくなった？
records.en_original: Still feel lonely?
records.en: Still feel lonely?

records.jp: ……ふふ。はい
records.en_original: Hehe... Not anymore.
records.en: Hehe... Not anymore.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
